text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Packed with Falco's LOVE and sparkle— 
Tarumae-chan, happy birthday!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wah... You remembered!\nThank you so 
much, Falco-san!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For Tarumae-chan, a local idol giving her 
all in both lives and races... we have a 
special surprise!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco... will turn into a cooking idol 
just for you today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Tarumae-chan, do you like 
meunière? I had some Hokkaido salmon and 
butter ordered in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And for dessert, a haskap berry tart! Make 
sure you come hungry and look forward to 
it☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, doing all this for me...? I'm 
so moved! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A great senior who walks the same path of 
an Umadol... For someone like her to give 
me a birthday present...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm so glad you like it, Falco's 
super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...The fun of an unexpected present, the 
thoughtfulness to cater to their tastes, 
and above all, those adorable gestures 
that capture your heart!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I've taken all your idol know-how to 
heart! Thank you so much, Falco-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, whoa, whoa-hold on! The idol 
study session is for next time, got it?☆"
